name: macOS device journey
description: How a Mac was enrolled, the groups that resulted, and everything that reaches it.
note: Covers every enrolment route - Automated Device Enrolment, Apple Configurator, direct enrolment, device enrolment manager and Company Portal. A Mac enrolled through Setup Assistant legacy may have no Microsoft Entra device object at all: the report still runs and explains what group-targeted policy cannot reach. Devices managed by app protection policy alone are not enrolled in Intune and are out of scope.

fields.label: Device name or serial number, or two separated by a comma
fields.hint: One device to trace its journey, two to compare them. Exact match, case-insensitive.

fields.label: Also write an interactive HTML report
fields.hint: A single self-contained file. Opens in any browser, works offline.
